name: Shelfmark
description: Shelfmark is a self-hosted web interface for searching and requesting books and audiobooks across multiple sources (web, torrent, usenet, IRC), with metadata search via Hardcover, Open Library, and Google Books. Pairs well with Calibre-Web, Calibre-Web-Automated, and Audiobookshelf for automatic imports.

paths.name: Config Path
paths.description: Config, database, and artwork cache directory.

paths.name: Books Path
paths.description: Default destination for downloaded books. Point this at your Calibre-Web/CWA/Grimmory ingest folder for automatic import.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID the container runs as.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID the container runs as.
